title: ETangMo SMP Season 2 Modpacks
description: Modpack for 🍉 ETangMo SMP Season 2 Private Server
body:
## 📌 Announcement
**From now on, this modpack will no longer receive updates.** After my friends and I had a great time playing on our private Minecraft server, it’s finally time to say goodbye. Even though this is just a small modpack with nothing fancy, I’m incredibly grateful for every download. It truly means a lot to see people showing interest in it. Thank you for support ❤️

Moving forward, this modpack will be archived.
— 8/7/2026


> 
![title](https://i.ibb.co/C3Gvrc7D/minecraft-title2.png)
> 


## ✨ About this modpack

It's **very simple quality of life improvements** and a **cartoon-style aesthetic** modpack. This pack enhances the gameplay experience without changing the vanilla feeling too much. Focus on **ETangMo SMP Season 2**. A Private Server that i play with my **friends**.

This is a starter modpack for my **friends** and you can **enjoy same experience** like my friends too.🎉

## 🔑 Keys Features
- Simple **Performance Optimized**
- Simple **Quality of Life** Mods
- Simple **Voice Chat** for Proximity voice chat
- Aiming for **Beauty** and **Semi-Vanilla** like

**Perfect** for players who want a **better Minecraft experience** with **improved visuals** and **helpful features** while keeping the game **simple** and **fun**.
